text:
maya: T-20m for the dawn rollout. Quick sync: Oliver on pins, Tina on verification, SRE monitor. @oliver @tina
oliver: Got it. Will pin redwood-api v3.5.0 to the dedicated pool after canary passes. Preflight checks green locally.
tina: I'll run smoke and user-flow QA. Keeping an eye on sample-gen diffs.
deploy-bot: Rollout plan queued: canary -> us-east-1 8% traffic, bake 10m, expand to 40% if stable. Migration steps: none.
sre-bot: Alerts armed: latency-p95 > 200ms, error-rate > 1% auto-page. Also tracking "embedding-cpu" metric.
maya: If the canary shows increased cost without errors, do we prefer batch reduce or quantize toggle?
oliver: Prefer batch reduce first (less risk). I have a quick command: `scripts/set_batch.sh redwood-api 0.5`
tina: Smoke checklist (short): health, 50 sample generations parity, embeddings mean diff < 0.7%, auth flows. I'll paste output.
05:50:00Z tina: warmup started
05:58:10Z deploy-bot: canary launched us-east-1 @8% (id: 1728007777-canary). Bake timer started.
06:02:03Z tina: smoke run 1: 50/50 pass, embeddings diff 0.4%, 1 minor timing out which retried fine. Traces -> s3://releases/dawn/1728007777/smoke1.log
maya: Good. Hold for another smoke in 5m. Oliver, have rollback command handy?
oliver: Yep:
```
# instant rollback to stable
deploy-bot rollback --service redwood-api --to stable-3.4.9
# abort rollout
deploy-bot abort --id 1728007777-canary
```
sre-bot: Observability note: p95 currently 180ms, error-rate 0.3%, cost 1.08x baseline. No pages.
maya: OK proceeding with expansion to 40% in us-east only. Do NOT touch eu or apac until we confirm image digest across regions.
oliver: Running expansion: `deploy-bot rollout --id 1728007777-canary --percent 40 --region us-east-1`
06:15:30Z deploy-bot: expansion live.
06:20:45Z tina: smoke run 2: 200/200 pass, no parity regressions. No auth failures.
06:25:00Z ux-support: Support FYI: drafting a short note for #support with known regional rollout and troubleshooting tips (will include rollback link).
maya: Decision points captured: 
- fast functional regression (>1% increase): immediate rollback
- latency-only spike (p95 > 250ms) but errors low: reduce batch, enable quantize for canary
- image digest mismatch in other regions: pause region rollout, coordinate with CI for manifest republish

06:30:00Z sre-bot: Slight CPU rise on embeders but below threshold. Continuing monitoring.
oliver: Since canary is healthy, I'll pin v3.5.0 to dedicated pool in 10m and unpin legacy flags after 1h. Command: `redwoodctl pin set redwood-api@dedicated --version=v3.5.0`
maya: Handover: Tina will own 06:30-07:00UTC verification, Oliver remains pin/unpin and rollback owner, Maya remains overall coordinator. This thread is the single source of truth for today.
tina: Confirmed. I'll post final smoke + logs here before we unpin.
06:45:00Z tina: final smoke: all checks green. No anomalies.
maya: Great. Proceed to pin when ready, Oliver please post pin command output.
oliver: Pinned to dedicated pool: success. Now scheduling unpin of svc-legacy in 1h.
maya: Thank you team. Locking thread for operational cadence. If anything triggers thresholds, call the page and reply here. :lock:
